name: Li-Ion Batteries: Technology and Thermal Management
description: Lithium metal to graphite electrode - Birth of Lithium-ion batteries; Pre-lithium-ion batteries -realm of Lithium batteries; Transition of Lithium-ion batteries from portable to mobility applications; Transition of Lithium-ion batteries from small scale to large scale storage applications; working of lithium-ion batteries – positive electrode, negative electrode and electrolyte; Role of cathode in lithium-ion batteries; Ni-rich/Mn-rich and Fe-based Lithium battery cathodes; graphite, alloy and silicon based anodes for Lithium-ion batteries; solid-state Lithium-ion batteries; Lithium-ion batteries characterizations; testing and charging/discharging methods, Strategies to prolong battery life, Second-life, recycling and disposal of Li-ion batteries, Batteries and extreme weather conditions, Lithium-ion batteries manufacturing, pack designing, and safety issues; Battery system heat transfer and thermal management systems.
